title: Primary Care Provider Assignment: Continuity-of-Care Election
content:
**Transition-of-care policy — continuity of care when the assigned primary care provider leaves the Prairie Ridge network (Primary Care Provider Assignment).**

### Policy

When the provider of a member's active assignment is leaving the network, a member in active treatment may elect to keep seeing that provider after the network exit date; the election is recorded as a continuity-of-care referral to the exiting provider on the active assignment, and it records the visits the member may have with that provider in the continuity window that begins on the exit date.

A member is in active treatment with the exiting provider when the member had at least one visit with that provider in the last year, and a member whose visits all fall earlier than the last half-year is still in active treatment. The last year and the last half-year are trailing periods of twelve and six whole months counted back from the handling date, not calendar years or halves.

| Member's visits with the exiting provider | In active treatment |
|---|---|
| At least one in the last year, including one in the last half-year | Yes |
| At least one in the last year, all earlier than the last half-year | Yes |
| None in the last year | No |

The election is the member's own: the member makes it in person.

### Member election entry: `elect_continuity_of_care_ec21b6d4`

**Capability.** The member elects, in person, to keep seeing their primary care provider who is leaving the network, under continuity of care. One call records the member's election as one continuity referral entry, dated today and given a new referral number, on the member's active primary care assignment, naming the leaving provider and the number of visits the member may have with that provider after the provider's network exit date. Nothing else on the member's record changes; the member receives the referral number to give the provider's office.

**How it is invoked.** It is the customer's own tool: the representative unlocks `elect_continuity_of_care_ec21b6d4` with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves — the member — runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `pcp_assignment_id` | Reference number of the member's active primary care assignment with the provider who is leaving | As the representative reads it from the member's primary care assignment record and gives it to the member |
| `provider_npi` | NPI of the leaving primary care provider the member will keep seeing | 10-digit NPI, digits only, no spaces or punctuation |
| `referral_visits` | Number of continuity visits with the leaving provider that the election covers | Whole number of at least one visit, no decimals |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` (the text "elected" when the election was recorded), `pcp_event_id` (reference of the new referral history entry), `referral_number` (the continuity referral number in the form RF-YYMM-NNNNN), `provider_npi` (10-digit NPI of the leaving provider), `election_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `referral_visits` (integer continuity visits recorded). A receipt with status "elected" means the member's continuity of care is on record.
